description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet në katin e 7-të të një objekti ndertuar ne 2010, me orientim jug-perëndim-veri,
Orientim i cili ofron ndriçim natyral gjatë gjithë ditës.
Hapësirë funksionale dhe e përdorur maksimalisht.
Apartamenti shitet i mobiluar, por ka hapsire për blerësin të personalizojë sipas preferencës.
Sistem chiller, me inverter ne cdo dhome.
Organizimi:
Salloni ne te cilen ndodhet dhe kuzhina, ka dalje ne ballkon dhe orientohet perendim.
Dhoma martesore me hapsire te bollshme, me garderobe.
Dhoma e femijeve e kompletuar me mobilim.
Informacion shtesë:
-Ashensori ne objekt shkon deri ne katin e gjashte, kalimi per katin e shtete behet nga shkallet.
Hapsirat e perbashketa kane ndricim natyral dhe diell.
Prona disponon hipotekë të rregullt.
description_en: The apartment is located on the 7th floor of a building built in 2010, with south-west-north orientation, which offers natural lighting throughout the day. Functional and maximally used space. The apartment is sold furnished, but there is room for the buyer to customize according to preference. Chiller system, with inverter in every room. Organization: The living room, in which the kitchen is also located, has access to the balcony and is oriented west. Matrimonial room with ample space, with wardrobe. Children's room complete with furniture. Additional information: - The elevator in the building goes up to the sixth floor, the passage to the second floor is done by the stairs. Common spaces have natural lighting and sun. The property has a regular mortgage.
